name: IZMO Ltd
tagline: Automotive digital-imaging/CRM software firm whose silicon-photonics / semiconductor-packaging bet has moved from lab-stage to early commercial (40 GHz defence package shipping, Rs 45-50 Cr FY27 guide, Rs 40 Cr order book) — but a serious promoter-integrity overhang (past SEBI misleading-disclosure finding; promoter's bail revoked in a duty-evasion case) and unaudited US books keep conviction Low
business_overview: Core: automotive retail software — world's largest automotive image/animation library, OEM-certified CRM/ILM, plus FrogData (US auto-dealer analytics). New: izmo Microsystems — silicon-photonics chip packaging; named a Photonics Chip Packaging Partner in the CoE-CPPICS (IIT Madras) and a packaging partner in India's National Silicon Photonics Mission.
fundamentals_table: TTM Rs 285 Cr (~+26% YoY); FY26 net profit ~Rs 48 Cr, EPS ~Rs 31.8, OPM ~18%
Revenue Rs 65.4 Cr (+15.7% YoY), operating EBITDA Rs 16.4 Cr (+69.6% YoY, margin 25.1%, +796 bps), PAT Rs 12.2 Cr (+103% YoY)
Q1 FY27 revenue Rs 9.24 Cr (2nd quarter at this base); FY27 guidance Rs 45-50 Cr; order book Rs 40 Cr, pipeline Rs 100 Cr; 40 GHz RF defence package shipping
Promoter holding 34.8% (rising); debtor days ~165; working capital ~142 days; no dividend; US subsidiary books unaudited
fundamentals_narrative: Two businesses. The core auto-retail software business (image library, OEM CRM/ILM, FrogData US dealer analytics) is modest-quality (low-teens ROCE/ROE) but is currently executing well - Q1 FY27 operating EBITDA margin jumped ~800 bps to 25% and PAT doubled, helped by the FrogData rollout into the FordDirect dealer ecosystem. The swing factor is izmo Microsystems: since the last pass it has moved from lab-stage to early commercial - a 40 GHz RF semiconductor package now in production shipment for defence, a Rs 40 Cr order book, a Rs 100 Cr pipeline and management guiding Rs 45-50 Cr of FY27 revenue, with a fund-raise planned to build toward ~Rs 1,200 Cr addressable capacity (revenue from Q3 FY28). This is real progress, but the segment is still only ~Rs 9 Cr/quarter and the promoter-integrity overhang (a 2017-18 SEBI misleading-disclosure finding, a criminal duty-evasion matter against the MD with bail revoked in Dec 2025) plus unaudited US books remain the dominant risk.
technical_read: Not pulled. Community notes >50% drawdown from the top and repeated lower circuits in 2025.
sentiment_summary: Read the most recent ~32 of ~85 posts (topic 18631), 2024–Aug 2026. Bulls (Agastya, Nabendu – 29 loves) frame it as a VC-like asymmetric bet on photonics. A sustained, well-supported bear thread runs alongside: SEBI found IZMO's claims about a defence subsidiary (Hughes Precision Manufacturing) misleading in 2017-18 (Debojit_Kangsa_Banik); promoter Sanjay Soni had bail revoked by the Bombay High Court in an ammunition import-duty-evasion case (rajpanda, Dec-2025); US books of accounts not audited (Phaeton); management loose on guidance and 'shifts goalposts' (anna).
community_signal: rajpanda (elevated trusted user) posted the bail-revocation news (16-Dec-2025) — a risk flag, not a conviction call. No trusted-roster bull call. No formal high-conviction call logged.
bse_notes: Not independently checked. Governance history is the key issue: a prior SEBI finding of misleading disclosure (2017-18) and a criminal duty-evasion matter against the promoter with bail revoked (2025). Promoter holding is rising (~35% toward a stated ~40%), so this is not a 'promoter-holding-collapse' red flag, but promoter integrity is a live concern.
bull_case: izmo Microsystems has moved from lab-stage to early commercial: 40 GHz RF semiconductor package in production shipment for defence/secure comms; Rs 40 Cr order book, Rs 100 Cr pipeline, Rs 45-50 Cr FY27 revenue guidance
Designated Photonic IC Packaging Partner for India's National Silicon Photonics Mission (CPPICS / IIT Madras) - a first-mover / regulatory-designation edge with no named domestic competitor
Fund-raise planned to scale toward ~Rs 1,200 Cr addressable capacity (implementation mid-FY28, revenue from Q3 FY28) - asymmetric payoff vs a Rs 1,360 Cr mcap
Core auto-software is executing: Q1 FY27 operating EBITDA margin +~800 bps to 25%, PAT +103% YoY, near debt-free, FrogData scaling in the FordDirect US dealer ecosystem
Geopolitical tailwind: US-China decoupling in optical transceivers / defence electronics
bear_case: Promoter integrity: a 2017-18 SEBI misleading-disclosure finding plus a criminal duty-evasion matter against the MD with bail revoked by the Bombay High Court (Dec 2025)
US subsidiary accounts not audited; overseas-revenue legitimacy questioned by the community for years; debtor days ~165 and working capital ~142 days
Photonics/semicon segment is still tiny (~Rs 9 Cr/quarter) and capacity-scale revenue is 2+ years out (Q3 FY28); execution + fund-raise dilution risk
Core business has historically under-delivered vs guidance ('shifts goalposts'); no dividend despite consistent profit
P/E ~25x already embeds a growth premium on the core; the option is real but binary
verdict_headline: Photonics/semicon bet is now early-commercial, not just lab-stage - four-box clears at 3.0 - but the promoter-integrity overhang and unaudited US books hold conviction at Low
verdict_reasoning: Deep-dive four-box scores 3.0 (tailwind yes, tam yes, moat weak, valuation weak): the semiconductor-packaging platform now has production shipments, an order book, revenue guidance and a national-mission designation, so this is no longer a pure 'unproven technology' - thesis_fit 10x-in-2-3-years stands.

Conviction stays Low, not higher: (a) governance - a SEBI misleading-disclosure finding and an active criminal matter against the MD with bail revoked, plus unaudited US books that fund a growing share of revenue; (b) the semicon segment is still ~Rs 9 Cr/quarter with scale revenue not due until Q3 FY28; (c) a fund-raise implies dilution.

Not tagged a formal red-flag tier - no negative net worth, no promoter-holding collapse (holding is rising), no current SEBI order - but the governance caveats dominate; treat as a speculative, small-sized position, not a core idea.
Upgrade trigger: two-three quarters of izmo Microsystems revenue tracking to/above the Rs 45-50 Cr guide, a clean audit of the US books, and clarity on the promoter's legal matter.

Conviction held at Low by the promoter-integrity overhang, unaudited US books, still-tiny segment scale and fund-raise dilution risk.

earnings_quality.normalised_note: Q1 FY27's 25% operating EBITDA margin is well above the FY26 ~18% level; some is genuine leverage but a through-cycle core margin is more likely ~18-21%. Treat 25% as an above-trend print, not the new base.

growth_trajectory.last_quarters_note: Revenue YoY: Q1 FY27 +15.7%; FY26 full-year ~+26%; PAT growth much faster (Q1 FY27 +103% YoY) on margin expansion. Semicon segment newly at a ~Rs 9 Cr/quarter base from near-zero.
growth_trajectory.reverse_pe_note: ~25x needs ~20%+ EPS CAGR; core is delivering that on margin expansion, but the PAT-growth rate is flattered by a low base and an above-trend margin quarter - sustainable rate is likely lower than the last print suggests.

management_quality.capital_allocation: Retaining all earnings (no dividend) to fund the semicon pivot - defensible given the opportunity, but unproven. Historical capital allocation into the core built a niche global position at low-teens ROCE. The new-segment bet is large relative to the balance sheet and will need external capital.
management_quality.capability_ladder_note: Explicit move up the value curve: automotive imaging/CRM -> data analytics -> advanced semiconductor/photonic-IC packaging

quality_metrics.open_questions: FCF conversion not reliably derivable from public snippets given ~142-day working-capital cycle and unaudited US books; needs the FY26 cash-flow statement to confirm CFO/EBITDA.

track_record.note: FY22-FY26 checked for revenue growth >=10% AND ROCE >=15% in the same year. Revenue growth cleared 10% in most years, but ROCE has generally sat ~12-14%; only FY26 (revenue ~+26%, OPM ~18%, ROCE near ~14-15%) is a plausible clear, and even that is borderline. Consistency of the >=15% ROCE bar is not established.

four_box.note: tailwind=yes (silicon photonics / defence electronics / India semicon mission, US-China decoupling). tam=yes (Rs 1,360 Cr mcap vs a Rs 1,200 Cr addressable-capacity ambition + large OSAT TAM). moat=weak (national-mission designation + defence qualification give a first-mover edge, but Kaynes/Tata are building the same capability - upgraded from 'no' now that product is shipping). valuation=weak (~25x P/E prices the core; semicon is an unpriced but binary option). Score 3.0 -> 10x-in-2-3-years permitted; conviction held Low separately on governance.
